blocks.html: On August 3, as the public was first learning about Professor Jason Arday, then of the Cambridge Faculty of Education and Jesus College, Tyler Austin Harper posted a thread challenging the way elite institutions have implemented diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) strategies. Elite schools select mediocre black candidates for symbolically important "first-ever" positions while passing over stronger black scholars. "There are plenty of talented black academics, and these elite schools step over their bodies to elevate scrubs who either come from rich families ([Claudine] Gay) or who let them feel the warm glow of the white man’s burden (Arday)."
While popular attention continued to struggle with the (easy) question whether Arday was an academic fraud and serial fabulist, Harper
